summary: This document defines the TLS Certificate Status Version 2 extension, which lets clients support several certificate status methods; the use of Certificate Status is commonly called OCSP stapling. It also defines an OCSP-based method that lets servers give status for intermediate certificates in the chain, not just their own. It was later replaced by RFC 8446 and RFC 9846.
